cacheColdStarts.title: Prompt caching is not paying off
cacheColdStarts.body: Only {ratePct}% of your prompt tokens were served from cache, against a healthy {targetPct}%. Long-lived sessions and stable system prompts are what let a provider reuse work you already paid for.

retrySpend.title: Retries are a real share of the bill
retrySpend.body: {sharePct}% of this window's spend went on attempts that were superseded, across {logicalTurns} turns. This is measured from the ledger, not estimated.

runawaySession.title: One task dominated the window
runawaySession.body: A single work unit of {turns} turns accounted for {sharePct}% of the spend. Often that is the task that was worth doing, and worth knowing about either way.

unpricedSpend.title: Part of this window has no price
unpricedSpend.body: {sharePct}% of turns ran on {models} model(s) with no known rate, so the {knownCostUsd} shown is a floor rather than the whole bill.
